limitations: Recipe admission/execution and target checks are a library foundation; managed session catalog/runtime/UI and remote recipe transport are not integrated yet.
RecipeTarget constructor validates shape only; concrete host adapter must attest the actual binding, canonical cwd and immutable checkout stamp.
CommandExecutor owns a Unix process group; target adapter still requires sandbox/process-tree ownership, isolated HOME/config/credential store and executable identity through spawn.
Managed recipe execution requires an unambiguous template and SHA-256 executable pin; read-only recipes are denied.
Local HTTP runtime regression uses production relay/proxy/sandbox with controlled keyring and HTTP substitutes; this is not runtime recipe acceptance.
No Chromium rerun, native macOS acceptance, real account, service, keyring or tailnet acceptance.
Recipes/service workflow integration, full E5.3/E10 acceptance and remaining E0-E10 stay open.
